# model fixtures

The data model's forms (`indra/llinventory`): type tables, permissions, sale
info, items and categories in their LLSD, legacy text and message forms, and
their CRCs.

Filled by recorder R1 of the inventory rung (vkstorm-rust rung seven). The
fixtures are recorded from the unmodified viewer C++, before any port commit,
on Windows and Linux, and are never edited by hand. To change them, change the
recorder and record them again.
